title: Palindrome Checker
description: Check if any word, phrase or number reads the same forwards and backwards, with options to ignore case, spaces and punctuation.
howto: Type or paste your text into the box.
Choose whether to ignore case, spaces and punctuation.
See instantly whether it is a palindrome, plus the cleaned text and the longest palindromic part.

faqs.a: Text that reads identically forwards and backwards. With "ignore spaces and punctuation" on, "A man, a plan, a canal: Panama" is a palindrome.
Yes. Numeric strings like 12321 or 1221 are checked the same way as words.
The longest contiguous substring of your text that is itself a palindrome, found with an expand-around-center scan.
